description: This file defines a configuration class `LambdaAIChatConfig` that extends an OpenAI-like chat configuration, specifically for Lambda AI's API compatibility. It provides methods to specify the LAMBDA AI provider and retrieve API base URL and key settings.

classes.name: LambdaAIChatConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for Lambda AI's chat API, extending OpenAILikeChatConfig with specific properties and methods for Lambda AI compatibility.

methods.name: Optional[str] custom_llm_provider(self)
methods.description: Property that returns the string 'lambda_ai' indicating the LLM provider.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Optional[str]] _get_openai_compatible_provider_info( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str] )
methods.description: Method that returns the API base URL and API key, defaulting to Lambda AI specific values if not provided.
